system.description:
Apply only the Expertise benefit of this known stance.

You have studied in the Iron Fist fighting style. A closed fist fighting style, designed to break bone and directly injure opponents:

Your [Unarmed Damage] die becomes a d6. If wearing Combat Bracers this instead becomes 1d8 if Strength is your Taijutsu ability score.

While in this stance, your unarmed attacks gain the Heavy weapon property, but ignore the Ability score requirement.

Beginning at 5th level, Once per turn, in place of one of your attacks granted by the Attack action, you can perform a Bone Breaking Strike.

Bone Breaking Strike. Make an unarmed attack, dealing your [Unarmed Damage] and forcing a Strength saving throw vs your Taijutsu save DC on a hit. On a failure, the damaged creature has their AC reduced by 1 and are Bruised until the beginning of your next turn.

Beginning at 10th level, Your [Unarmed Damage] is doubled when dealing damage to a structure or construct. When a creature fails their saving throw against Bone Breaking Strike, their AC is instead reduced by 2 for the duration.
